svg.title: Çılgın Kurye LED board: strip layout 0.1.0 (1:1, mm)
svg.text: Strip layout 0.1.0 from city plan 0.2.0: 788 LEDs (5.5 m), 13 per segment, road pitch 118 mm, gap at crossings 27.7 mm.
Chain A: east-west roads and stores (398 LEDs). Chain B: north-south roads (390 LEDs). Arrow = data direction, dashed = jumper wire, A12 = first LED index.
View from above. North is up. Sensor and motors sit under the base.
